challenge.method: Compare an ordinary saved value, a saved pointer to mutable state, and the source's nil-function-value case. Check the timing around setting result parameters.
challenge.results: A deferred call receives the value captured at deferral. A saved pointer can observe later changes to the pointee. The specification puts the nil-function panic at invocation and places pending normal defers after any explicit return results are set but before control returns to the caller.

limitations: The proposition covers normal return through normally completing deferred calls. Saved references retain access to mutable state, and panic and process exit are separate cases.
